newsitem.title: DUBAI: Parsons wins Saudi gas project management deal.
newsitem.headline: Parsons wins Saudi gas project management deal.

text.p: U.S. engineering firm Parsons has won a 750 million riyal ($200 million) deal to project manage the Hawiyah gas processing plant in eastern Saudi Arabia, a Saudi newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The English-language Arab News said Parsons "has bagged a 750 million riyal contract for the project management of the Hawiyah plant".

State oil giant Saudi Aramco has gone to the market for the construction of the $2 billion gas plant at the Hawiyah producing zone of the huge Ghawar oilfield in its largest expansion of gas processing in more than a decade.
The Hawiyah plant will be able to process 1.44 billion cubic feet a day of gas.
Under the project, which will come onstream between 2002-2003, Hawiyah will be connected by pipeline to Riyadh's power stations. ($1=3.75 riyals)
